(447)༄༅/bde chen zhing sgrub 'don 'grigs bzhugs/bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi las/dang po rnam pa yang nas yang du yid la byed pa tshogs zhing gsal ba

tei:div.tei:p: bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi las/ dang po rnam pa yang nas yang du yid la byed pa tshogs zhing gsal btab pa ni/ e ma hoḥ sogs nas/ bdag gi sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes pa'i bar 'don/ rgyu gnyis pa dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa sgo du ma nas bsags pa la/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ dkon gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ phyag 'tshal ba'i gzung lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do/ skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes 'od dpag med mtshan brgya rtsa/ de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug gtor can dang*/ sman bla/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bcas bdun re/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras chen brgyad dang*/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdun re/ gzhung gi chos sku snang ba mtha' yas= bde gshegs 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes pa'i bar gsum/ gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag ni/ maṇḍal rgyas bsdus rnams dang*/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod= zhes bar tshar gsum/ gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ ltung bshags tshar gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'= bdag skyabs mchi/ bar lan gcig spyi bshags/ bla ma rdo rje= lan gsum/ pha mas thog drang= nas/ bdag rgyud yongs su dag par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes bar tshar gsum/ bdag sogs lus kyi las ni= nas ltung bshags gsham (448) nang*/ phyir bsngo'o/ bar/ tshul khrims rnam dag gzungs/ khrims kyi tshul khrims= shlau ka rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su bdag slob gyur= shlo ka/ yan lag phyi ma bzhi lhan gcig tu/ gzhan gyi dge ba nas/ mi lus don dang ldan pa 'grub bar shog bar lan gsum/ rgyu gsum pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i= sogs/ byang chub snying por= lan gsum/ ji ltar sngon gyi= lan gsum/

bla ma mtshams pa'i phyag srol de gnyis sbrel nas lan gsum btang srol yod/ deng dus bdag tshe= smon lam 'grub par shog zhes rgyas pa dang*/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang= shlau ka lan gsum/ byang chub mchog shlo ka lan gsum/ rgyu bzhi pa dge ba'i rtsa ba de rnams bde ba can du skye ba'i phyir bsngo zhing smon lam gdab pa nang gses dang bcas pa ni gzhung ltar/ bdag dang bdag la= nas/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar sangs rgyas= swa hāḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ smon lam 'grub pa'i gzungs bcas brjod/ rgyas par gsal 'debs sogs nang gses dang bcas pa 'brel pa ltar ro// zhes pa'ang bla ma byams pa mtha' yas kyis bskul ngor mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun bzang dpal ldan zhal snga nas gsung rim bzhin thub bstan chos kyi glang pos yi ge'i ris su bris pa dge// bkra shis//
